description: A white blocky chair-like piece sits on the bed in front of a pillow, with a smaller white rectangular part nearby. The right hand lifts the small piece, moves it up and to the right, and aligns it with the top-right side of the larger chair piece while the left hand slides in to steady the larger piece; the right hand presses the small piece into place and then eases off, leaving the left hand still supporting the assembled structure.
